blind.description: A square-profile red brick chimney stack featuring running bond brickwork with grey mortar, a slightly stepped/corbelled brick crown near the top, and a cylindrical terracotta chimney pot with an open flue on top. Geometry is solid, clean, and stylized, with flat ground contact and no floating or melted parts.
blind.from_above: A square red brick collar with defined outer segments enclosing a circular terracotta rim with a dark open center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 ft tall), and about 1.5 to 2 ft wide at the crown.
